const reason = 'Each update reads the previous write';
inOrder(items, step, {reason});
inOrderSteps([step], {reason});
inOrder(items, step, {
 // Order uses the previous result.
 reason: 'Each update reads the previous write'
});
async function run(items, step, reason) {
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder(items, step, {reason});
}
